propositions: A new advisory AGENT-tier CONTAINER criterion 'decomp-shape' must be registered in registry.CANONICAL_LLM and registry.AGENT_TIER (facet: container, not codebase-grounded) and added to pass1.CONTAINER_CRITERIA to detect layer-cake architectural partitions and producer-consumer artifact dependencies without ordering edges

The criterion must be routed via criteria_routing.json with exec:AGENT, facet:container, scope:container, and default_posture:advisory, with an accompanying rubric prompt at reviewers/plan_review_decomp_shape.md and regenerated guide section in plan-review-criteria-guide.md

The eval_solver container-arm must be extended to run container criteria via pass1_container when a fixture carries a children: list, enabling bounded sanity testing of decomp-shape without E2/E3 corpus or batch eval

The criterion auto-flows into the standing effectiveness recorder with zero per-criterion wiring, and its advisory→blocking promotion is gated on both dogfood-detected effectiveness AND E6's order-stability (fleiss_kappa floor clearance), deferred until both conditions pass

Deterministic unit tests must validate registration invariants, routing shape, prompt contract, eval fixture threading, and effectiveness auto-inclusion; bounded sanity must fire on hand-authored layer-cake and consumed-artifact-without-ordering-edge plans and remain clean on vertical-slice and ordered plans
